question: Which agricultural technique was promoted by the Green Revolution as against traditional farming?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Scientific Farming**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Green Revolution focused on promoting scientific farming** techniques over traditional farming methods to increase agricultural productivity.
 
• **This included:**
 
 
• **Use of High-Yielding Variety (HYV) Seeds**:
 
 
• Specially developed seeds were introduced to improve crop yields significantly.
 
 
 
• **Chemical Fertilizers and Pesticide**s:
 
 
• Extensive use of synthetic fertilizers and pesticides to enhance soil fertility and protect crops from pests.
 
 
 
• **Irrigation Techniques:**
 
 
• Improved irrigation infrastructure to ensure consistent water supply.
 
 
 
• **Mechanization:**
 
 
• Introduction of machinery like tractors and harvesters to reduce manual labor and enhance efficiency.
 
 
 
• **Scientific Research and Development:**
 
 
• Agricultural practices were backed by research and scientific studies to optimize productivity.
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ​The** Green Revolution was a period of agricultural innovation in the 1960s that increased crop yields, especially of wheat and rice**.
 
• It involved the** development of new varieties of seeds, the use of chemical fertilizers and pesticides, and improved irrigatio**n systems
 
• The Green Revolution was a period of agricultural innovation in the 1960s. 
 
• The Green Revolution was marked by the development of high-yielding seed varieties.
